_comment: Teacher-facing setup steps, copied into download/manifest.json by tools/build.py. Plain words only: the reader is an economics teacher, not a programmer. {zip}, {skill}, {skill_txt} and {instructions} are replaced with the file names. Providers are listed in the order we recommend them. Button names must match each AI's screen (docs/ROADMAP.md).

title.zh: Grok（建議使用，香港可直接使用）

en: Download {zip}. Do not unzip it.
Go to grok.com and sign in. Open Projects and create a new project, e.g. "DSE Economics Diagrams".
Copy the instructions text (below, or {instructions} inside the zip) into the project's Instructions.
Upload {zip} to the project's files.
To draw: open the project and start a new chat.
zh: 下載 {zip}，不用解壓。
前往 grok.com 並登入。打開 Projects（專案），建立新專案，例如「DSE 經濟圖」。
把指示文字（見下方，或 zip 內的 {instructions}）複製到專案的 Instructions（指示）。
把 {zip} 上載到專案的檔案。
要畫圖時：打開該專案，開始新對話。

title.en: Claude (needs a VPN in Hong Kong)

en: Download {zip}. Do not unzip it.
Go to claude.ai (web or app) and sign in. Open Settings ▸ Capabilities and turn on "Code execution and file creation".
On the same page, under Skills, click Upload skill and choose {zip}.
To draw: start any new chat. Claude uses the skill by itself, with no instructions needed.
zh: 下載 {zip}，不用解壓。
前往 claude.ai（網頁版或 App）並登入。打開 Settings ▸ Capabilities，開啟「Code execution and file creation」。
在同一頁的 Skills 下按 Upload skill，選擇 {zip}。
要畫圖時：開始任何新對話，Claude 會自動使用這個技能，不用另外輸入指示。

title.en: ChatGPT (needs a VPN in Hong Kong)

en: Download {zip}. Do not unzip it.
Go to chatgpt.com and sign in. In the sidebar, click New project, e.g. "DSE Economics Diagrams".
In the project's settings, paste the instructions text (below, or {instructions} inside the zip) into Instructions.
Upload {zip} to the project's files.
To draw: start a new chat inside the project.
zh: 下載 {zip}，不用解壓。
前往 chatgpt.com 並登入。在側邊欄按 New project（新專案），例如「DSE 經濟圖」。
在專案設定中，把指示文字（見下方，或 zip 內的 {instructions}）貼到 Instructions（指示）。
把 {zip} 上載到專案的檔案。
要畫圖時：在該專案內開始新對話。

title.zh: 畫圖（任何 AI 都一樣）

en: Paste the question and its marking scheme. Nothing else is needed.
The AI replies with the finished diagram: in Chinese for a Chinese question, in English for an English one, one picture per part.
Right-click the picture ▸ Save image as… and put it in your worksheet.
Want a change? Say it in words, e.g. "make demand steeper", "move 'shortage' lower" or "English too", and it draws it again.
If the AI gives you code instead of a picture: open colab.new, paste the code, and press ▶. The picture appears and downloads.
zh: 貼上題目和評卷參考即可，不用再寫其他指示。
AI 會直接回覆畫好的圖：中文題目畫中文圖，英文題目畫英文圖，每一分題一張。
在圖片上按右鍵 ▸「另存圖片」，即可放進工作紙。
要修改？直接用文字說，例如「需求曲線畫斜一點」、「把『短缺』移低一點」或「也要英文版」，它會重畫。
如果 AI 給你程式碼而不是圖片：打開 colab.new，貼上程式碼，按 ▶，圖片會顯示並自動下載。

title.zh: 快速方法（不用建立專案）

en: Start a new chat in your AI and attach {zip}.
Type: "Use the attached dse-econ-graph skill." Then paste the question and its marking scheme.
Next time, attach {zip} again in the new chat.
zh: 在 AI 開始新對話，附加 {zip}。
輸入：「使用附件的 dse-econ-graph 技能。」然後貼上題目和評卷參考。
下次開新對話時，再附加一次 {zip}。

title.en: When there is a new version

en: Download {zip} again.
Grok / ChatGPT: in your project's files, remove the old {zip} and upload the new one. If the instructions text changed, paste the new text into Instructions.
Claude: in Settings ▸ Capabilities ▸ Skills, remove the old skill and upload the new {zip}.
zh: 重新下載 {zip}。
Grok / ChatGPT：在專案檔案中刪除舊的 {zip}，上載新的。如指示文字有更新，把新文字貼到 Instructions（指示）。
Claude：在 Settings ▸ Capabilities ▸ Skills 刪除舊技能，上載新的 {zip}。
